display_name: Interpretation Law 5741-1981, with the surviving provisions of the Interpretation Ordinance [New Version]
display_name_he: חוק הפרשנות, התשמ״א–1981, ופקודת הפרשנות [נוסח חדש]
citation: Interpretation Law 5741-1981, Sefer HaChukim 5741, p. 302 (amended 5750 p. 90, 5751 p. 30, 5754 p. 358); Interpretation Ordinance [New Version], Dinei Medinat Israel 5714, p. 2 (as amended)
extent: The State of Israel. The Law applies to every enactment and administrative direction, including one given before the Law commenced on 1981-10-01, unless another provision deals with the matter or the matter or its context is inconsistent with the Law (Law s. 1). Of the Ordinance, the Law's s. 31 leaves in force only ss. 16(2), 16(4), 17, 19 and 42.

source.note: Unofficial. Both carry the amendments. The official Knesset PDFs (fs.knesset.gov.il) could not be fetched from the network used: every request returned an HTML page titled "Unavailable". Nothing has been verified against the gazette. The Legal Data Hunter index does not carry the Law. See source/SOURCES.md.
source.official_texts: source/official/OFFICIAL-SOURCES.md: six Knesset PDFs (the Law as enacted, its three amendments, the Ordinance [New Version], the Rest Days Ordinance 1948) fetched 2026-10-13 through an Israeli address because fs.knesset.gov.il refuses requests from Singapore.
